# Lillian's Interiors

> Lillian's Interiors provides premier wallpaper and wallcovering installation services for luxury residential, commercial, and unique spaces. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, and founded by master craftsman Lillian Weist, we have been installing coast to coast since 1982.

## Main Sections

- [About](https://www.lilliansinteriors.com/#about) — Our story, heritage, and affiliation with the National Guild of Professional Paperhangers.
- [Services](https://www.lilliansinteriors.com/#services) — Laser-focused wallpaper hanging and wallcovering expertise.
- [Portfolio](https://www.lilliansinteriors.com/#portfolio) — Real-world transformations across residential, commercial, and unique spaces.
- [Process](https://www.lilliansinteriors.com/#process) — Our five-step installation journey: Discovery, Design, Wall Prep, Installation, and Reveal.
- [Praise](https://www.lilliansinteriors.com/#testimonials) — Testimonials and feedback from our clients.
- [Contact](https://www.lilliansinteriors.com/#contact) — Request an estimate or get in touch.

## Core Services

- **Wallpaper Installation** — Expert hanging of pre-pasted and unpasted wallpapers with seamless pattern matching.
- **Custom Murals** — Installation of large-scale hand-painted Chinoiserie, custom murals, and hand-crafted paper products.
- **Texture & Specialty** — Complex pattern alignment, textured wallcoverings, and specialty high-end finishes.
- **Consultation** — On-site space assessments and guidance on wallcovering selection.
- **Wall Preparation** — Removal of old wallpaper, wall repair, priming, and sizing to ensure a flawless substrate.
- **Mentoring** — Training and sharing 40+ years of paperhanging expertise with future craftspeople.
